values.note: Active-duty military 25% off daily camping (subject to availability, free park admission); veterans 10%; seniors 60+ 10%; former POWs and 100% disabled veterans 50% off daily and 30-day camping. Discounts cannot be combined and apply only to the senior or veteran staying on the site.

note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District park on Piedmont Lake, with a marina. Lakeside sites are 2-8 at the northeast end of the loop, by the campground dock. --Claude
